summary: The root is associated with wealth.

senses.definition: Scripture uses this word for wealth.

note:
Drafted for coverage of Psa.44.13; cognate research remains open.

Root (2026-11-21): Filed under the hollow root הון: the verb occurs once, וַתָּהִינוּ 'you made light of going up' (Deu 1:41), as Arabic هَانَ 'be light, easy' (Lane p. 3046). How 'wealth' comes from it is not clear; Jewish Aramaic הוֹנָא is 'capacity, wealth'.
